title: Which trade chips could Red Sox use to acquire another impact bat?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox seek another impact bat following Curtis Mead's injury, with MLB's trade deadline on Aug. 3.
Top prospect Franklin Arias could be a key trade chip for acquiring players like Miami's Otto Lopez or Washington's CJ Abrams.
Red Sox pitchers Payton Tolle, Jake Bennett, and Anthony Eyanson are potential trade assets for bolstering the lineup.

title: Wellfleet police release plea for help from public in 2025 homicide
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Timothy Duval Jr., 24, was killed in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, after being struck by a vehicle in May 2025.
Wellfleet Police and local DA seek public assistance in investigating the 2025 homicide of Army veteran Duval.
Authorities urge anyone with information to contact Detective Jack Poska at 508-349-2100 for the ongoing investigation.

title: New report sheds light on Curtis Mead’s potential return to Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Curtis Mead of the Boston Red Sox won't need surgery for his broken wrist, offering a potential return in 6-8 weeks.
Mead, injured in his Boston debut after being hit by a 95 mph fastball, has been officially placed on the injured list.
Acquired from the Nationals, Mead had a breakout season batting .256 with 17 home runs before the injury occurred.

title: Hennessy’s in downtown Boston has closed, plans to transfer liquor license to new Seaport restaurant
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Hennessy's Bar in downtown Boston has closed after nearly 30 years at 25 Union St. near Quincy Market.
Hennessy's is transferring its liquor license to Bar 23, a new restaurant opening in Seaport next year.
Bar 23, a spinoff of Grill 23, will offer a steak-focused menu and seat 75 patrons at 11 Fan Pier Blvd.

title: Framingham remote Logan terminal will be extended through March
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: The Framingham remote Logan terminal will continue operations until March, having served 10,000 passengers since June.
Delta and JetBlue passengers can access TSA screening and baggage check-in at the remote terminal before reaching Logan Airport.
Massport plans further remote terminal expansion and to include more airlines, citing operational success and high passenger demand.

title: Sonny Gray reportedly interested in signing extension with Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Sonny Gray, Boston Red Sox pitcher, is reportedly interested in signing a contract extension with the team.
Gray has been a key performer with a 12-2 record and 2.78 ERA over 106.2 innings this season.
Boston's Red Sox improved to an 18-4 record in July, boosting their position in the playoff race.

title: Teen driver killed, 4 others hospitalized in stolen SUV crash in Abington
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 17-year-old driver was killed in a crash involving a stolen Hyundai Santa Fe in Abington.
Four other teenagers, aged 14 to 17, were hospitalized with one ejected from the vehicle on impact.
The crash occurred during a police pursuit when the vehicle hit a tree at 877 Washington St.

title: Celtics ‘expressed interest’ in LeBron James in free agency before he joined 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Boston Celtics expressed interest in signing LeBron James before he joined the Philadelphia 76ers.
LeBron James signed a two-year deal with the 76ers, joining a team featuring Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown.
Even at 41, James averaged 20.9 points, 6.1 rebounds, and 7.2 assists per game last season with the Lakers.

title: Parts of Mass. under flash flood warning as state sees heavy rain
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Flash flood warning in effect until 6 p.m. for parts of Western Massachusetts, including Springfield and Chicopee.
Berkshire County faces flood warning until 5:45 p.m. due to heavy rainfall across the region.
Massachusetts may receive 1-4 inches of rain, with some areas like Berkshire County expecting up to 7 inches.

title: Cyclist, 39, killed in Stoughton crash
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Mark Salvador, 39, was killed in a cycling accident on Washington St. (Route 138) in Stoughton.
The accident occurred shortly after 5 a.m., leading to Salvador's death at a Boston hospital an hour later.
The crash is under investigation, with no details on any potential driver involvement or charges released.
